figs.cap: Scanning electron microscopy images of square artificial spin ice arrays patterned by electron-beam lithography (EBL). The nanomagnets have lateral dimensions of l₁=430 nm, w₁=100 nm, and a₁=700 nm for S1 (a); l₁=430 nm, w₁=140 nm, and a₁=700 nm for S2 (b); and l₁=430 nm, w₁=100 nm, and a₁=530 nm for S3 (c). During FORC measurements, the field was applied along the [1,1] direction of the lattice. The scale bar is 400 nm.
(a) Processed family of FORCs acquired for S1. (b) Corresponding FORC diagram of S1.
(a) Representative FORCs of S2. (b) Corresponding FORC diagram in the Hᵤ–H_c coordinate system. Inset: zoomed-in view of the central peak with a boomerang-shaped feature.

(a) A family of FORCs for S3 with the applied field along the [1,1] direction of the lattice. (b) Corresponding FORC diagram plotted in the H_c–Hᵤ coordinate system. Inset: zoomed-in view of the central peak highlighting its vertical spreading.
